roc_auc: macro one-vs-rest multiclass ROC-AUC over classes 1..5
pr_auc: macro unweighted mean of per-class one-vs-rest average precision (AP), not trapezoidal PR curve area
note: This supplemental post-hoc metric calculation uses already selected and saved v3 models; it does not retrain or alter v3 model selection. Majority sequence AUC/AP use one-hot probabilities derived from saved hard labels, so they are tie-score baselines.
